term: causes as caused (the per se link of a series of efficient causes; Lean `CausesAsCaused`)
definition: `CausesAsCaused c x`: c efficiently causes x only insofar as c is itself, here and now, efficiently caused. c is a middle cause (medium) of a per se ordered series of efficient causes: remove its cause and its causing is removed. 'No infinite regress' is well-foundedness of this relation (`NoInfinitePerSeEfficientCauseSeriesReading`). It is a relation between efficient causes, distinct from the mover link `MovesAsMoved` (DEF-PER-SE-ORDERED-SERIES); STMT-PER-SE-MOVER-LINK-IS-PER-SE-CAUSE-LINK is the explicit premise that every per se mover link is such a cause link.
note: q.2 a.3 gives the order (primum est causa medii, et medium est causa ultimi; remota causa, removetur effectus) and q.46 a.2 ad 7 restricts the impossibility of regress to per se ordered efficient causes. Which caused causes count as middle causes is the reading choice recorded by the two claims on q.2 a.3: the strong reading -A (caused in any respect) and the relevant-respect reading -B.
